_comment: TOOL is public code, documentation and measurements of the tool itself.
DATA is real runtime output, versioned in a separate PRIVATE companion.
Credentials are gitignored projections of an external credential store and are never versioned.
Real DATA is physically absent from this public source tree, including ignored paths.
_audited: Runtime Config requires the selected root to sit in a separate Git worktree outside this source tree before reading product data or resolving writes (path checks only; visibility is not checked at runtime). Metrics, compliance and per-run destinations are canonicalized and confined to that selection. Explicit/environment selections cannot fall through to another product. Public-tree DATA patterns remain declared even though runtime writes occur in the companion. Existing hardlinked runtime files are rejected.
_data_home: The authoritative Config root, selected explicitly or with PROMOTION_ASSISTANT_CONFIG. Config requires a separate versioned PRIVATE Git companion; no source-tree or unversioned fallback is allowed.
